gateTitle: Gate R7 — Emulator OEM-Lifecycle Baseline Qualification
qualificationBoundary: Executed on emulator-5554 (API 36, Android 16, x86_64). Validates Android OS lifecycle contracts; does not certify physical OEM hardware (Samsung OneUI, Xiaomi MIUI, Pixel physical hardware) or proprietary battery management daemons. Physical OEM qualification remains a separate required gate.

R7-01.name: Light Doze behavior and throttled timer resilience
R7-01.expected: OS enters light IDLE; app background work throttles safely; PID preserved
R7-01.observed: force-idle light executed: Now forced in to light idle mode; state: IDLE; PID=28159

R7-02.name: Deep Doze behavior and maintenance window compliance
R7-02.expected: OS enters deep IDLE; network suspended; maintenance window respected; PID intact
R7-02.observed: force-idle deep executed: Now forced in to deep idle mode; state: IDLE; PID=28159

R7-03.name: App Standby buckets and inactivity transitions
R7-03.expected: App marks Idle=true on inactive, returns valid bucket, returns Idle=false on active

R7-04.name: Low Memory Killer memory trimming (RUNNING_MODERATE, RUNNING_LOW, RUNNING_CRITICAL)
R7-04.expected: All ascending trim levels (RUNNING_MODERATE, RUNNING_LOW, RUNNING_CRITICAL) handled without crash; PID stable
R7-04.observed: Trims applied to PID 28378. PSS Memory: Before=150.9MB, After=125.6MB

R7-05.name: Background process termination cleanliness
R7-05.expected: App sent to background, terminated completely, zero zombie threads or remaining PID
R7-05.observed: am force-stop successfully killed process; PID is null

R7-06.name: Process resuscitation and state recovery from cold dead state
R7-06.expected: Fresh process spawned, React Native JS engine boots, window gains top focus
R7-06.observed: Cold launch succeeded in 2119ms; New PID=28470; Focus acquired

R7-07.name: Battery Saver mode system perturbation
R7-07.expected: System enters battery saver (low_power=1); app retains layout contrast and focus
R7-07.observed: Battery unplugged; low_power=1 confirmed; app focus maintained

R7-08.name: Wakelock audit: zero held wakelocks during background idle
R7-08.expected: Zero unreleased or persistent partial/full wakelocks held in background
R7-08.observed: Active unreleased wakelocks held by package: 0 (Wake Locks section verified 0)

R7-09.name: WAL durability after lifecycle interruption and hard kill
R7-09.expected: Interrupted COMMITTING write forward-completed via idempotency ledger; zero data corruption
R7-09.observed: Reconciled op state: COMMITTED; Balance preserved at 5000000 paise

R7-10.name: Rapid background/foreground cycling stability (5 consecutive cycles)
R7-10.expected: Five consecutive rapid background/foreground cycles completed without crashes, unexpected process termination, listener accumulation, or memory-growth regression
R7-10.observed: 5 cycles completed. PID=28470 (stable across cycling). Median cycle: 890ms, Worst cycle: 910ms; zero memory-growth regression

R7-11.name: Recovery without duplicate financial operations on replay
R7-11.expected: Replaying duplicate payload detects identical idempotency key; zero duplicate entries written
R7-11.observed: Duplicate detected; marked COMMITTED via NO_OP; Exactly 1 ledger transaction recorded

R7-12.name: Recovery without balance drift across lifecycle events
R7-12.expected: Total balance post-recovery exactly equals pre-recovery sum; zero drift (0 paise)
R7-12.observed: PreSum=35000000 paise, PostSum=35000000 paise, Drift=0 paise

R7-13.name: Offline queue preservation during background lifecycle and restarts
R7-13.expected: Offline intent queue perfectly preserved in storage across process kill
R7-13.observed: Recovered 2 queued mutations; order and payload intact

R7-14.name: Pending-operation reconciliation without duplicated writes
R7-14.expected: Engine reconciles pending queue operations and drains queue cleanly
R7-14.observed: Recovery taxonomy state: AVAILABLE; Queue drained to 0 pending items

R7-16.expected: Private data sandbox directory verified with sandboxed Linux UID isolation

R7-17.name: Network loss and restoration handling
R7-17.expected: Network loss handled fail-safe; offline storage functions normally; reconnect smooth

R7-18.expected: Storage layer fails closed under disk-full pressure without data corruption; op marked RETRYABLE_FAILURE

R7-19.expected: Cold relaunch under memory pressure completes within bounds; PSS < 180MB
